newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Food group downgraded by DLJ.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Food group downgraded by DLJ.

text.p: -- Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette downgraded its group of food stocks, a DLJ source said Thursday.
-- ConAgra Inc, Hormel Foods Corp, Ralston Purina Co, Sara Lee Corp, CPC International Inc and Hudson Foods were cut to market perform from buy, the source said.
-- Hershey Foods Corp and Flowers Industries Inc were cut to underpform from market perform.
-- The broker cited recent price escalation.

ConAgra shares were down 1-3/8 at 50-1/4, Hormel was off one at 26-5/8, Ralton fell 1-3/8 at 74-1/8, Sara Lee declined 3/4 at 36-7/8, CPC fell two at 79-3/8 and Hudson was down 1/8 at 18. Hershey shares were off 1-7/8 at 45-3/4 and Flowers declined 1-1/2 to 22-1/8.
